definitions.explanation: The act of forcefully propelling something outward, such as ejecting a pilot from an aircraft or launching a projectile.
In manufacturing, the process of forcing molten material into a mold, as in injection molding.

notes:
Composed of {射|しゃ} (to shoot) and {出|しゅつ} (to go out). Describes forceful outward propulsion. The two main usage domains are military/aviation (ejection) and manufacturing (injection molding).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {射出|しゃしゅつ}⟦{座席|ざせき}→座席：02832_zaseki⟧: ejection seat
- {射出|しゃしゅつ}{成形|せいけい}: injection molding
- {射出|しゃしゅつ}{成形|せいけい}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: injection molding machine
- ⟦{緊急|きんきゅう}→緊急：11327_kinkyuu⟧{射出|しゃしゅつ}: emergency ejection
- {射出|しゃしゅつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to eject / to inject

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発射|はっしゃ}→発射：03695_hassha⟧: launch / fire — firing a weapon or launching a rocket
- ⟦{噴射|ふんしゃ}→噴射：15045_funsha⟧: injection / jetting — spraying or jetting out a liquid or gas
- ⟦{脱出|だっしゅつ}→脱出：13934_dasshutsu⟧: escape — getting out of a dangerous situation, broader than {射出|しゃしゅつ}
